title: Android Wear complications display null using native algorithm
symptom: The watch face displays bg values correctly, and when using xdrip algorithm with g5 values displayed properly on complication. Now using G6 and native, complication displays null.
cause: The issue was caused by using the G6 sensor with the native algorithm, which was not properly syncing back-filled data to the Wear complication.
fix: Update to the July 26th nightly build, which addresses the issue and enables syncing of back-filled data. For Wear 2.0 devices, uninstall and reinstall the wear app because it doesn't automatically update.
evidence_quote: Please try the July 26th nightly, it should address this and also enable syncing of back-filled data.
